CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.26.0...3.31.10)
# Copyright © from 2022 to present, UNKNOWN STRYKER. All Rights Reserved.
PROJECT(ImGUI-1.91.6
        VERSION 0.0
        DESCRIPTION "Dear ImGUI 1.91.6"
        LANGUAGES CXX)

GET_FILENAME_COMPONENT(IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR} ABSOLUTE)
INCLUDE("${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../CMake/predefined-settings.cmake")
INCLUDE("${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../CMake/frogman-engine.cmake")

INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
FILE(GLOB DEAR_IMGUI_1_91_6 "${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.h" "${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.cpp")




IF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows")

SET(IMGUI_BACKEND
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx11.h
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx12.h
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx12.cpp
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_glfw.h
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.h
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp
)

ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Android")

SET(IMGUI_BACKEND
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_android.h
${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_android.cpp
)

ENDIF()


ADD_LIBRARY(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} STATIC ${DEAR_IMGUI_1_91_6} ${IMGUI_BACKEND})


IF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "x64")
    IF(SIMD STREQUAL AVX512F)
        SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/Debug
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/RelWithDebInfo
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/Release
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX512F/MinSizeRel
        )
    ELSE()
        SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/Debug
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/RelWithDebInfo
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/Release
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/X86-64/Windows/AVX-SSE2/MinSizeRel
        )
    ENDIF()

ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Android" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "ARM64")
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG          ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Android/Debug
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Android/RelWithDebInfo
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE        ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Android/Release
ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL     ${IMGUI_CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Binaries/ARM64/Android/MinSizeRel
)

ELSE()
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "System not selected.")

ENDIF()
